bio.text: Richard Hudson has served in the U.S. House since 2013 and represents North Carolina's 9th Congressional District.
He serves in House Republican leadership in the 119th Congress and is on the Energy and Commerce Committee, chairing its Subcommittee on Communications and Technology.
Hudson grew up in Charlotte, earned a B.A. in history and political science from the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, and lives in Southern Pines.
